question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Tourists from __all around the world__ visit Agra to see the Taj mahal.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Far and wide**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• "**Far and wide**" means over a large area or distance, and is an appropriate substitute for "all around the world." (किसी बड़े क्षेत्र या दूरी पर)

 
 
• **Example**: *News of the rare comet spread far and wide, attracting stargazers from different countries to witness the celestial event.*
 
 
 
• The phrase is often used to describe the reach or scope of something, such as a person's influence or a product's availability.
 
• Grammatically, "far and wide" functions as an adverbial phrase modifying the verb "visit."

Therefore, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Ever and anon**" means occasionally or from time to time. (कभी-कभी या समय-समय पर)
 
• "**Cut and dried**" means something that is straightforward or settled. (कुछ ऐसा जो सीधा या सुलझा हुआ हो)
 
• "**Few and far**" means scarce or hard to come by. (दुर्लभ या कठिन होना)
